name: ① flow inbox (pwa4, 最近20)
sql: SELECT source, "timestamp", event_id, status, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM pwa_balance_msg_flow WHERE source='pwa4' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 20;

name: ② 加钱流水 history (PWA4, 最近20)
sql: SELECT id, from_user_id, to_user_id, balance_change, left_balance, change_type, ext_id, created_at FROM pwa_user_balance_change_history WHERE change_type='PWA_USER_BALANCE_CHANGE_TYPE_PWA4' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20;

name: ③ 钱包余额 user_balance (注意列名是 update_at 不是 updated_at)
sql: SELECT user_id, balance_type, balance, update_at FROM user_balance WHERE user_id IN (2100045711,2100059898) ORDER BY user_id, balance_type;

name: ④ 死信表 dead (最近20)
sql: SELECT id, topic, "partition", "offset", err_code, err_msg, created_at FROM pwa_balance_msg_dead ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20;

name: A 一致性: flow=FINISH 但 history 缺行 (应0行)
sql: SELECT f.source, f."timestamp", f.event_id FROM pwa_balance_msg_flow f LEFT JOIN pwa_user_balance_change_history h ON h.change_type='PWA_USER_BALANCE_CHANGE_TYPE_PWA4' AND h.ext_id=f.event_id WHERE f.source='pwa4' AND f.status='FINISH' AND h.id IS NULL;

name: B 一致性: 同(change_type,ext_id)重复加钱 (应0行)
sql: SELECT change_type, ext_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM pwa_user_balance_change_history WHERE ext_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY change_type, ext_id HAVING count(*)>1;

name: C 一致性: 卡住的未完成flow(>5min) (应0行)
sql: SELECT source, event_id, status, updated_at, now()-updated_at AS stale FROM pwa_balance_msg_flow WHERE status IN ('INIT','PROCESSING') AND updated_at < now()-interval '5 minutes';

name: D 索引核对: pwa4 链路四张表
sql: SELECT tablename, indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('pwa_balance_msg_flow','pwa_balance_msg_dead','pwa_user_balance_change_history','user_balance') ORDER BY tablename, indexname;
